script:
Retirement aakumbol ₹10 crore veno?
But aduinu vendi monthly ethra invest cheyanam aruylee?

Ithunekkal important aaya oru question ind....

Eppozhal  anu start cheyyendathu?

Because retirement time planning ill, nigal invest cheyunna amount neekatum, your time anu powerful.

Oru simple example Parayam.

25 vayassil SIP start cheyuna oraalum pinne 35 vayassil start cheyuna oraalum same ₹10crore target anu nokkunathenkil.....

So 35 start cheyda aal monthly more investment cheyandi verum.

Why?

Compounding.

Nigalude paisaykku grow cheyyan nigal koodutal time kodukkumbol, time will work for you.

So retirement planning "retirement adukkumbol nokkam" enna mind ala venda.

Innu start cheyyuna oru small SIP, nalle nigalude biggest financial advantage akkam.

So, ₹ 10 crore retirement target annenkil, eppozha start cheyyanam?

title: The 40:40:20 Strategy
caption:
Your mutual fund portfolio il ee 3 buckets, undo? 

Just picking good funds alla matter, cheyyunnath…
how you allocate them can matter too.

40:40:20 strategy enthaanu?
And which bucket is your portfolio missing?

#404020 #MutualFunds #MutualFundInvesting #PortfolioAllocation #AssetAllocation #InvestmentStrategy #LongTermInvesting #WealthCreation #PersonalFinance #FinancialPlanning #InvestingTips #MutualFundPortfolio #MoneyManagement #InvestSmart #FinanceIndia
script:
Mutual fund portfolio il right funds choose cheythaal mathiyo?

Not really.

A good mutual fund portfolio is not just about picking the right funds. 
Athu engane allocate cheyyunnu ennathum equally important anu.

Athinu oru simple framework anu 40:40:20 Strategy.

First 40% Hybrid funds.

Ee portion Multi Asset Funds or Balanced Advantage funds il allocate cheyam.

Market conditions change cheyyumbol, these funds can adjust their allocation accordingly.

So, market volatility koodumbol, portfolio ude overall risk manage cheyan idu help akum.

Next 40% are diversified equity funds.

Ithanu nigalude core growth bucket.

For example, one large-cap fund + one multi-cap fund pole diversified exposure build cheyam.

Ivade main focus Long term wealth creation anu.

Short term market movements kandittu panic aakenda. Give your investment time to compound and let them do their job.

And the final 20% are small-cap or mid-cap funds.

Idu anu comparatively higher risk bucket.

Risk obviously kooduthal anu,
but athinoppam higher growth potential um undaakum.

So, simple ayi paranjal:

40%- Stability 
40%- Core growth 
20% -Higher growth potential 

Three buckets, three different rules, 
and together they can create a more structured portfolio.

But remember, 40:40:20 is a framework, not a size-fits-all formula.

Your goal risk appetite and investment horizon  anusarichuu  you are allocation should be decided.

So, nigalude portfolio il ee 3 buckets il which one is missing let us know?
